interfaces.protocol: Old PROTOCOL v1 and strict schema1 preserved. RUNTIME_LEASE_PROTOCOL v2: READY binding original7 plus runtime_lease; CLOSED original8 plus exact bool lease_expired and exact int lease_observed_ns, schema2.
interfaces.execution: Existing supervisor owns autonomous deadline checks before drain/GO and during loop, original nonce frames and owned TERM/KILL/ECHILD_WALL.
interfaces.compatibility: Optional runtime_lease keyword preserves original five positional constructor arguments and pre-Popen fallback. v2 known-expired start raises known expiry without poisoning process uncertainty; validated CLOSED avoids redundant STOP while awaiting supervisor exit.

baseline.note: Full original source was captured before edits and archived byte-exact; no old-version missing-helper/import error is classified as a product red.

Actual post-Popen constructor failure carries correctly bound fallback and actual supervisor exit.
Four malformed wire controls mutate an actually received closure after process exit; these are strict decoder checks, not fresh false-tree reproductions.
Actual validated closure with explicit waitpid visibility ordering double: no redundant STOP, wait still required.
